test_drop_duplicates: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates() to remove duplicate rows with keep='first', 'last', or False
test_drop_duplicates_subset: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates(subset) to remove duplicates based on a single column or list of columns
test_drop_duplicates_inplace: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates(inplace=True) to remove duplicates in place and return None
test_drop_duplicates_ignore_index: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates(ignore_index=True) to reset index after removing duplicates
test_drop_duplicates_with_duplicate_colu: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates() with duplicate column names in the DataFrame
test_drop_duplicates_NA: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates() handling of None and NaN values in columns
test_drop_duplicates_tuple: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates() with tuple column names
test_drop_duplicates_empty: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates() on empty DataFrames with various configurations
test_drop_duplicates_non_boolean_ignore_: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates() raises ValueError for non-boolean ignore_index argument
test_drop_duplicates_series_vs_dataframe: test DataFrame.drop_duplicates() produces consistent results with Series.drop_duplicates()
